nodes.label: Suspect checkpoint
nodes.role: A checkpoint that may carry a backdoor. Backdoored checkpoints are a supply-chain risk for openly shared models.

nodes.label: Weight interpolation
nodes.role: A mixing weight blends the weights of the suspect model with a clean model. Published work showed that merging a suspect model with other models can reduce backdoor behavior.
nodes.source: Published baseline: Here's a Free Lunch, Sanitizing Backdoored Models with Model Merge (ACL 2024)

nodes.label: Selective versus global
nodes.role: Averaging every weight or only chosen ones, as a concept.

nodes.label: What is measured
nodes.role: Backdoor behavior is measured as attack success rate and task behavior as clean accuracy.

nodes.label: What is not shown
nodes.role: Results, counts, datasets, checkpoints, code and thesis text from the group's experiments are not public.
